address: Politiebureau West (Overtoomsesluis), Hoofdweg 785, Amsterdam: the whole 2009 Hoofdweg block (police bureau shares the pand with housing and shops)
notes: 2009 block on the Hoofdweg / Overtoomse Sluis, 83 m long, 22.6 m eaves with 29.8 m wings and 33.5 m end towers, 561 LoD2.2 wall surfaces (the police bureau is a ground-floor tenant; the pand is the whole block). East front (panel 14, 2022-04-29 w01-72): brown brick, five rows of white-framed windows in groups, light stone ground floor with shops (signs of an eye therapist, a foot clinic, a bike shop), stepped brick towers with a crenellated parapet. North wall (panel 34, 2024-09-18 w03-342): eight rows of paired windows over an open pilotis ground floor with white square columns.

Ornaments: no POLITIE lettering, blue lamp, striped band, canopy or crest is visible on the east or north walls in these panoramas, so none is modelled (not present, not skipped: the bureau entrance is not on a photographed wall). Modelled: shop plinth on the east front. Simplified: the crenellated parapet with its row of tiny windows (a 0.5 m notch pattern, the parapet is the LoD2.2 roof edge), the white balcony-like projecting window boxes on the north wall (flat paired windows), the pilotis colonnade on the north wall (ground left blank; the columns stand 1 m clear of the wall and would be 14 separate boxes, left to the 3DBAG shell, which already carries the soffit).

BLOCKED, do not install: gate footprint-vs-bag fails at IoU 0.749 (budget passes at 11,664 tris). The 3DBAG LoD2.2 ground polygon is 3,888 m2 against the BAG footprint of 5,191 m2: the arcades and pilotis (open ground storey of the north and south wings) have no ground surface in the 3DBAG shell, so the shell cannot reach IoU 0.90 whatever the intent says. Needs a largeCompile hook that adds the missing ground footprint or a gate exemption decided by the integrator; the intent itself is otherwise ready.

East front groups: the 22.6 m parts (surfaces 319, 50, 139, 43) and the 29.8 m wings (15, 337, 140, aligned to the same storeys, upper 2 storeys blank above the fifth row); surface 44 (33.5 m tower), the west side (panel 137, 2022 candidates 0), the south and courtyard walls have no usable panorama and stay blank.
